rule.eligible: Open next actions, open loops (open_loop, team_loop, action_required) and pool candidates whose creating actor is not a human partner. Partner-created rows never expire. Renewal-radar candidates are excluded because their sealed daily snapshot owns that membership.
rule.clock: Latest of created_at, the last keep (confirmed_at), and the last update by a human partner.
rule.stale: Clock plus days is in the past. Stale next actions leave today-triage and the Home agenda; stale loops leave the morning brief loop queue. Stale candidates stay on the claim card until expired.
rule.expired: Stored status written only by drop or expire_all_matching. Kept for history and reversible with keep.

read.access: Verified partner or a partner-sponsored agent. Rows another partner owns are left out.
read.groups: One group per kind and bucket (stale, expiring_this_week) with total and up to limit rows (default 50, max 200).

apply.items: [{kind, id, version, action: keep|drop}], 1-500 rows, one idempotency_key. Any not-found, other-partner or version refusal changes nothing.
apply.keep: Assigns the partner as owner (next actions, loops), sets confirmed_at, restores an expired row.
apply.drop: Stores status expired; loops also record closed_at and an 'expired:' close_outcome.
apply.expire_all_matching: {kind, created_by, created_from, created_before, owner?, text_prefixes?}; timestamps carry an offset; partner creators refused; other-partner rows skipped and counted; at most 10000 matches.
apply.dry_run: true returns would-counts, matched, skipped_other_partner and a 10-row sample with no write and no idempotency key.

consumer_adoption: The app pins this contract before rendering the Home Clear the deck card. Use the row version from the latest read; a version_conflict means re-read.
